name: Komachikawa
source:
A female detective who serves as the main character of the exclusive scenario "Komachikawa Detective Agency" in Viper-V8 R.

Business is slow for freelance private investigator Komachikawa. When she gets a phone call claiming that a young boy is being held hostage in a run-down house in the slums, Komachikawa investigates, only to find out the house is haunted and the kidnapper isn't who he seems.
